description: Sink — write a pandas DataFrame to an OData v2/v4 entity set via POST / PATCH / DELETE.

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset producing the DataFrame to write
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

csrf_fetch_path.label: CSRF Fetch Path
csrf_fetch_path.description: Path to fetch x-csrf-token from before writes.

skip_columns.description: Columns to drop before serializing the row body (e.g. internal pandas columns).
skip_columns.label: Skip Columns

batch_mode.description: Use OData $batch protocol — bundles many writes into one HTTP request. Supported by S/4HANA and SuccessFactors. NOT supported by all OData servers; leave off unless you're sure.
batch_mode.label: Batch Mode ($batch)

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key (e.g. 'event_date', 'created_at').

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value (e.g. 'customer_id', 'region').

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' fires one query covering the whole backfill range (partition_key/partition_date/partition_start/partition_end tokens reflect the full range, comma-joined for partition_key) rather than one query per partition. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set. 'single_run' requires a partition-range-aware IO manager (e.g. a DB-table IO manager with partition_expr set) -- a generic filesystem/default IO manager cannot persist a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and will raise a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

name: Dataframe → OData
